instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lenis' for smooth scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
2. FONTS: Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.css.
3. THEME: Force DARK MODE. The app should look like a premium dark room.
4. HERO: Use the 'hero_bg' image with a heavy overlay (gradient from transparent to #050505) so text is readable. Title should be HUGE (text-6xl md:text-8xl) in Cormorant Garamond.
5. FEATURES: Build a 'Bento Grid'. Do not just stack cards. Make the 'Beautiful Galleries' card span 2 columns or rows to show off the image.
6. IMPACT: Use 'Fintech' style stats. Big numbers in JetBrains Mono or Manrope. Use the Emerald Green color here to signify money/charity.
7. WAITLIST: Make it a 'floating' section or a very clean, centered section at the bottom. Use a 'glow' effect behind the form.
8. ANIMATION: Use framer-motion for simple fade-ins (staggered) on scroll. No complex 3D unless necessary, keep it performant.
9. ICONS: Use 'lucide-react' with thin strokes (stroke-width={1.5}) to match the elegant vibe.
10. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' - no generic centered layouts without tension.
Use noise texture overlays to kill digital flatness.
Ensure contrast ratios are met (White text on #050505 is safe, but check grey text).
